title: ProductAttributeSetItem - Data API
description: Represents a set of attributes that can be associated with a product. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

Field.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

FieldApiName.description: A derived field whose values comes from CustomFieldDefinition object.

IsGroupedBy.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsGroupedBy.description: Indicates if product variations are grouped by a specific attribute. This field is available in API version 64.0 and later.

ProductAttributeSetId.description: The ID of the product attribute set.

Sequence.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Sequence.description: The order that product attributes appear in.

special_access_rules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access products.
